result.query: SELECT json_build_object('vpcs',(SELECT count(*) FROM network_vpcs WHERE state<>'deleted'),'subnets',(SELECT count(*) FROM network_subnets WHERE state<>'deleted'),'attachments',(SELECT count(*) FROM network_attachments WHERE state<>'released'),'eips',(SELECT count(*) FROM network_eips WHERE state<>'deleted'),'snats',(SELECT count(*) FROM network_snat_bindings WHERE state<>'deleted'),'lbs',(SELECT count(*) FROM network_load_balancers WHERE state<>'deleted'),'claims',(SELECT count(*) FROM network_eip_claims WHERE released_at IS NULL),'vip_intents',(SELECT count(*) FROM network_lb_vip_intents),'subnet_refs',(SELECT count(*) FROM network_lb_subnet_refs),'components',(SELECT count(*) FROM network_lb_components WHERE deleted_at IS NULL),'generated',(SELECT count(*) FROM network_lb_generated_resources WHERE released_at IS NULL),'platform',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id',resource_id,'kind',kind,'state',state,'reason',reason)) FROM network_platform_resources WHERE state<>'deleted'));
